metadata.name: Retention Policy Schema
metadata.description: Ensures assets have proper lifecycle and retention metadata. Use this to enforce data governance policies around asset expiry, archival, and disposal.

description: Enforces lifecycle and retention metadata for data governance compliance.

checks.name: retention-fields-present
checks.description: The asset states its retention period, the disposal method that applies once it expires, and the owner accountable for retention compliance.

checks.name: review-dates-recorded
checks.description: The last access review and the next scheduled retention review are recorded.
